lead.deck: UN climate talks in Antalya ended on Sunday with no agreement at all — the first collapse since Copenhagen in 2009 — after the EU, the UK and others rejected a final text that made no mention of fossil fuels. Nearly 200 countries leave the longest COP on record with no new climate-finance target and no fossil-fuel phaseout.
lead.headline: COP31 Collapses: No Deal as EU Walks Out Over Fossil Fuels
